evaluation.safety_evals: The developer reports that Kimi K2.6 delivers measurable improvements in real-world reliability, including enhanced safety awareness during extended research tasks.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card gives only a one-line safety claim and no design, training, or evaluation details for this exact checkpoint, so documentation is insufficient to assess its risks.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not describe training or tuning data for kimi-k2.6, so dataset composition and provenance are undocumented.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card states only broad image/text-to-text modalities and open weights, without specifying intended or prohibited uses, leaving downstream risk scope undefined.
